### SessionType

_A handle to an open executor session._

Syntax: `!executor.session`

A value-semantic handle to a session with an executor endpoint, produced by
`executor.open` and consumed by `executor.send_binary`, `executor.launch`,
`executor.call`, and `executor.close`.

#### Example:

```mlir
%s = executor.open("127.0.0.1:9000") : !executor.session
executor.close %s : !executor.session
```


### TokenType

_A handle to one launch that has not finished yet._

Syntax: `!executor.token`

Produced by `executor.launch_async` and consumed by `executor.await`, which waits for that
one launch.

#### Example:

```mlir
%t = executor.launch_async %s("serve", "/tmp/coproc.o")
    : !executor.session -> !executor.token
executor.await %t : !executor.token
```
